verdict.rationale: Navan documents card management and 'unlimited policy and approval workflows' (docs-7, docs-25) plus expense/policy-violation detection (docs-6, docs-22), implying some enforcement mechanism, but there is no explicit evidence of budget allocation to teams/projects or that card limits are tied to and enforce those allocations. missing for 10: dedicated budget-allocation-by-team/project feature, evidence that card limits are dynamically enforced against allocated budgets, and any hands-on/independent confirmation this works in practice.
